scope: StoNED evaluation envelope only; all 44 saved CNLS/QLE fits and all 230000 evaluation queries
LP: min b0+q'beta subject to b0+x_i'beta>=g_i, beta>=0, free b0
fallback_order: fresh identical LP and default presolve/scaling
fresh identical LP with presolve/scaling off
independent dual LP or normalized separating-ray LP
trigger: unresolved solver status or failed certificate, including apparently optimal but uncertified output
ray_strengthening: construct nonnegative slopes and lift the free intercept by feasibility residual plus a rounding guard, then recheck strict separation; certificate only, no estimated value is clipped
domain_definition: q lies in the convex hull of observed x plus the nonnegative orthant
outside_handling: preserve NaN prediction and explicit support exclusion; do not fabricate a prediction or label an unknown result outside without a certificate
